name: Find Image Online
summary: Find and display an image from the web using Wikipedia, Wikimedia Commons, or direct image URLs from search results.

steps.note: Search for '<subject> wikipedia' or '<subject> site:commons.wikimedia.org' — these sources allow fetching
Fetch the Wikipedia page — it contains direct image URLs in og:image meta tags or infobox
Look for: 1) og:image meta tag, 2) //upload.wikimedia.org URLs, 3) Direct .jpg/.png/.webp URLs in the page content
Output the image as markdown: ![description](https://url.to/image.jpg) — this renders inline in the chat

notes: NEVER try to fetch pexels.com, unsplash.com, pixabay.com, shutterstock.com — they block bots
If Wikipedia fails, try web_search for '<subject> filetype:jpg site:wikimedia.org'
Always render as markdown image syntax: ![alt text](url) so it displays inline
For generated images: use generate_image tool if an image model is loaded
